programme.title: Žogarija
programme.desc: Žogarija je projekt, ki uteleša eno naših najpomembnejših prepričanj – da šport lahko izboljša kakovost življenja mladih. Žogarija: harmonija generacij je serija oddaj, ki skozi pristne zgodbe in pogovore povezuje otroke, starše in stare starše. Vsaka oddaja prikazuje medgeneracijsko sodelovanje, igre, ustvarjalnost in vrednote družine v središču lokalnega dogajanja. Gre za toplo, življenjsko serijo, ki spodbuja povezanost in aktivno skupnost.

programme.title: La Vuelta
programme.desc: Dernière grande étape de montagne. Très dure, avec plus de 5000 mètres de dénivelé cumulé. La double ascension de Hazallanas (1re catégorie), avec le Purche (1480 m, 1re catégorie) entre les deux, mettra à rude épreuve les jambes des cyclistes qui devront affronter l'ascension finale vers le Collado del Alguacil (1880 m) sur 8,3 kilomètres à 9,8 %.

programme.title: La Vuelta
programme.desc: Grenade accueille l'étape finale de La Vuelta 2026, dont le principal attrait sera la montée vers l'Alhambra sur un circuit à travers les rues de la cité nasride. Le monument de Grenade couronnera le vainqueur final de la course lors d'une étape où le gagnant devrait être un cycliste explosif. Qui succèdera au palmarès de la Vuelta au Danois Jonas Vingegaard ?

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Angleterre
programme.desc: La finale de l'Open d'Angleterre oppose l'Anglais Ali Carter au Gallois Mark Williams à Brentwood. Un duel de vétérans du circuit mondial, dont l'âge combiné frôle les 100 ans.

programme.title: Alexander Zverev - Ben Shelton
programme.desc: La finale de l'US Open 2026 oppose le n°2 mondial, l'Allemand Alexander Zverev, au jeune espoir américain Ben Shelton, sur le court mythique du stade Arthur-Ashe, à New York.

programme.title: Trophée Matteotti
programme.desc: La 93e édition du Grand Prix de Fourmies fait partie du calendrier UCI ProSeries 2026 et s'élancera pour un parcours d'environ 200 km à travers l'Avesnois. Le sprinteur belge Milan Fretin fait partie des premiers noms confirmés pour la course aux côtés notamment du Néerlandais Olav Kooij et du Français Maxime Jarnet. L'an dernier, Paul Magnier s'était imposé lors d'un sprint massif.

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Angleterre
programme.desc: La finale de l'Open d'Angleterre oppose l'Anglais Ali Carter au Gallois Mark Williams à Brentwood. Un duel de vétérans du circuit mondial, dont l'âge combiné frôle les 100 ans.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Retransmission de manches de la Coupe du monde d'escalade. Organisée par l'IFSC depuis 1989, cette compétition annuelle se déroule à travers plusieurs étapes partout dans le monde. Trois catégories composent cette discipline : escalade de vitesse, de bloc, et de difficulté. Chacune d'entre elles donne un vainqueur dans sa catégorie. Il existe également un titre combiné pour les athlètes engagés dans deux catégories différentes.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Grand Prix de Québec
programme.desc: Le 15e Grand Prix cycliste de Québec se déroule au coeur du Vieux-Québec sur un circuit exigeant, marquant le début des Grands Prix canadiens, avant le Grand Prix de Montréal. L'an dernier, le Français Julian Alaphilippe s'était imposé avec deux secondes d'avance sur son compatriote Pavel Sivakov.

programme.title: Grand Prix de Montréal
programme.desc: Deux jours après le Grand Prix cycliste de Québec, les meilleurs coureurs du monde ont rendez-vous à Montréal. L'édition de cette année est spéciale, car elle sert de préparation directe aux championnats du monde de cyclisme sur route 2026 qui se tiendront à Montréal une semaine plus tard. Pour cette 15e édition, les organisateurs ont modifié le tracé habituel. Les coureurs vont tester, en avant-première, le circuit officiel des Mondiaux autour du mont Royal.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Guiyang, capitale de la province du Guizhou en Chine, accueille l'avant-dernière manche de la saison de coupe du monde de vitesse, en escalade. Chez les messieurs, les Chinois Zhao Yicheng, Shouhong Chu et Jianguo Long sont attendus à domicile, avec l'Américain Samuel Watson et le champion olympique indonésien Veddriq Leonardo. Chez les dames, l'Indonésienne Desak Made Rita Kusuma Dewi, victorieuse de deux manches sur quatre cette saison, est la favorite.

programme.title: Lone Star Le Mans | Les meilleurs moments
programme.desc: La course d'endurance des 6 Heures d'Austin 2026 se déroule sur le Circuit des Amériques, au Texas. Il s'agit de la 5e manche du Championnat du monde d'Endurance de la FIA (WEC).

programme.title: Chine | MXGP - Course 1
programme.desc: Suivez des courses du Championnat du monde de motocross. Chaque année, les meilleurs pilotes du monde s'affrontent pour le titre décerné par la Fédération internationale de motocyclisme. De mars à octobre, ils concourent sur 20 circuits en Europe, en Asie, en Amérique du Sud et du Nord. Le championnat du monde se déroule dans les catégories de moteurs MXGP, MX2 et MX3.

programme.title: Polo : Open de Grande-Bretagne
programme.desc: L'Open de Grande-Bretagne de polo, officiellement appelé British Open Polo Championship for the Cowdray Gold Cup, est le tournoi le plus prestigieux d'Europe. programme.title: Mark Selby - Noppon Saengkham
programme.desc: Le 16 août dernier à Taiyuan, Mark Selby est devenu le premier joueur à remporter l'Open de Chine à quatre reprises, après ses victoires en 2015, 2017 et 2018. MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Two Bills
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Guiyang, capitale de la province du Guizhou en Chine, accueille l'avant-dernière manche de la saison de coupe du monde de vitesse, en escalade. Chez les messieurs, les Chinois Zhao Yicheng, Shouhong Chu et Jianguo Long sont attendus à domicile, avec l'Américain Samuel Watson et le champion olympique indonésien Veddriq Leonardo. Chez les dames, l'Indonésienne Desak Made Rita Kusuma Dewi, victorieuse de deux manches sur quatre cette saison, est la favorite.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Retransmission de manches de la Coupe du monde d'escalade. Organisée par l'IFSC depuis 1989, cette compétition annuelle se déroule à travers plusieurs étapes partout dans le monde. Trois catégories composent cette discipline : escalade de vitesse, de bloc, et de difficulté. Chacune d'entre elles donne un vainqueur dans sa catégorie. Il existe également un titre combiné pour les athlètes engagés dans deux catégories différentes.

programme.title: La Vuelta
programme.desc: Grenade accueille l'étape finale de La Vuelta 2026, dont le principal attrait sera la montée vers l'Alhambra sur un circuit à travers les rues de la cité nasride. Le monument de Grenade couronnera le vainqueur final de la course lors d'une étape où le gagnant devrait être un cycliste explosif. Qui succèdera au palmarès de la Vuelta au Danois Jonas Vingegaard ?

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Angleterre
programme.desc: La finale de l'Open d'Angleterre oppose l'Anglais Ali Carter au Gallois Mark Williams à Brentwood. Un duel de vétérans du circuit mondial, dont l'âge combiné frôle les 100 ans.

programme.title: Alexander Zverev - Ben Shelton
programme.desc: La finale de l'US Open 2026 oppose le n°2 mondial, l'Allemand Alexander Zverev, au jeune espoir américain Ben Shelton, sur le court mythique du stade Arthur-Ashe, à New York.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Grand Prix de Québec
programme.desc: Le 15e Grand Prix cycliste de Québec se déroule au coeur du Vieux-Québec sur un circuit exigeant, marquant le début des Grands Prix canadiens, avant le Grand Prix de Montréal. L'an dernier, le Français Julian Alaphilippe s'était imposé avec deux secondes d'avance sur son compatriote Pavel Sivakov.

programme.title: Grand Prix de Montréal
programme.desc: Deux jours après le Grand Prix cycliste de Québec, les meilleurs coureurs du monde ont rendez-vous à Montréal. L'édition de cette année est spéciale, car elle sert de préparation directe aux championnats du monde de cyclisme sur route 2026 qui se tiendront à Montréal une semaine plus tard. Pour cette 15e édition, les organisateurs ont modifié le tracé habituel. Les coureurs vont tester, en avant-première, le circuit officiel des Mondiaux autour du mont Royal.

programme.title: Alexander Zverev - Ben Shelton
programme.desc: La finale de l'US Open 2026 oppose le n°2 mondial, l'Allemand Alexander Zverev, au jeune espoir américain Ben Shelton, sur le court mythique du stade Arthur-Ashe, à New York.

programme.title: Polo : Open de Grande-Bretagne
programme.desc: L'Open de Grande-Bretagne de polo, officiellement appelé British Open Polo Championship for the Cowdray Gold Cup, est le tournoi le plus prestigieux d'Europe. Il se tient chaque année en juillet au Cowdray Park Polo Club dans le West Sussex (Angleterre) et réunit l'élite mondiale de ce sport.

programme.title: Tennis : US Open
programme.desc: Retour sur les meilleurs moments de la 146e édition du tournoi de l'US Open, quatrième et dernière étape de la tournée du Grand Chelem. Qui a succédé à Alcaraz et Sabalenka ?

L'édition de cette année est spéciale, car elle sert de préparation directe aux championnats du monde de cyclisme sur route 2026 qui se tiendront à Montréal une semaine plus tard. Pour cette 15e édition, les organisateurs ont modifié le tracé habituel. Les coureurs vont tester, en avant-première, le circuit officiel des Mondiaux autour du mont Royal.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Guiyang, capitale de la province du Guizhou en Chine, accueille l'avant-dernière manche de la saison de coupe du monde de vitesse, en escalade. Chez les messieurs, les Chinois Zhao Yicheng, Shouhong Chu et Jianguo Long sont attendus à domicile, avec l'Américain Samuel Watson et le champion olympique indonésien Veddriq Leonardo. Chez les dames, l'Indonésienne Desak Made Rita Kusuma Dewi, victorieuse de deux manches sur quatre cette saison, est la favorite.

programme.title: Lone Star Le Mans | Les meilleurs moments
programme.desc: La course d'endurance des 6 Heures d'Austin 2026 se déroule sur le Circuit des Amériques, au Texas. Il s'agit de la 5e manche du Championnat du monde d'Endurance de la FIA (WEC).

programme.title: Cyclisme : Grand Prix de Québec
programme.desc: Le 15e Grand Prix cycliste de Québec se déroule au coeur du Vieux-Québec sur un circuit exigeant, marquant le début des Grands Prix canadiens, avant le Grand Prix de Montréal. programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Angleterre
programme.desc: La finale de l'Open d'Angleterre oppose l'Anglais Ali Carter au Gallois Mark Williams à Brentwood. Un duel de vétérans du circuit mondial, dont l'âge combiné frôle les 100 ans.

programme.title: La Vuelta
programme.desc: Dernière grande étape de montagne. Très dure, avec plus de 5000 mètres de dénivelé cumulé. La double ascension de Hazallanas (1re catégorie), avec le Purche (1480 m, 1re catégorie) entre les deux, mettra à rude épreuve les jambes des cyclistes qui devront affronter l'ascension finale vers le Collado del Alguacil (1880 m) sur 8,3 kilomètres à 9,8 %.

programme.title: La Vuelta
programme.desc: Grenade accueille l'étape finale de La Vuelta 2026, dont le principal attrait sera la montée vers l'Alhambra sur un circuit à travers les rues de la cité nasride. Le monument de Grenade couronnera le vainqueur final de la course lors d'une étape où le gagnant devrait être un cycliste explosif. Qui succèdera au palmarès de la Vuelta au Danois Jonas Vingegaard ?

programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: SportsCenter

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Two Bills
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ First Take
programme.desc: First Take (Sports). Stephen A. Smith joins host Molly Qerim on this weekday morning sports debate show. programme.title: ⋗ NFL Football: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs (Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, Missouri, USA)
programme.desc: NFL. Denver Broncos vs. Kansas City ChiefsThe Chiefs and Broncos meet in an AFC West game at Arrowhead Stadium in Week 1. Guests: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way
